subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw core own syncing external Control UI turns into Open WebUI visible history, and through what supported boundary?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but the implementation direction depends on maintainer intent for third-party Open WebUI persistence ownership, direct SQLite coupling versus an adapter/API path, opt-in configuration, and historical backfill behavior.

options.title: Design opt-in visible-history sync
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify a narrow Open WebUI sync contract with live proof before implementation.

options.title: Route through plugin or adapter
options.body: Keep core lean by adding only any missing core seam and requiring the Open WebUI-specific mirror to live behind an integration boundary.

options.title: Document unsupported co-editing
options.body: Decide that OpenClaw owns transcript/model context only for this workflow and document that Open WebUI visible history is not updated by Control UI sends.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in visible-history sync
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify a narrow Open WebUI sync contract with live proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Gateway chat/session path and recent session-store-key boundary history make this the best available routing owner for the storage-boundary decision.
